answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one knoll weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The opal report publishes the merge explicitly at each zenith. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 123 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 234 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1089 identities would post 4018 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
